questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: For what values of $n$ is the graph $K_n$ Eulerian?
options: Both odd and even values of $n$
questions.solution: We know that $K_n$, the complete graph of $n$ vertices is a connected graph in which degree of each vertex is $n-1$. Since, a graph is Eulerian if and only if it is connected and degree of each vertex is even, we conclude that $K_n$ is an Euler graph if and only if $n$ is odd.

questions.q: In the set $Q^{+}$of all positive rational numbers, the operation * is defined by the formula $a * b=\frac{a b}{6}$. Then, the inverse of 9 with respect to * is
questions.solution:
Let $e$ be the identity,
$\begin{array}{lrl}
\therefore & a^* e & =a \\
\Rightarrow & \frac{a e}{6} & =a \\
\Rightarrow & e & =6 \\
\because & a^* a^{-1} & =e \\
\therefore & a^* a^{-1} & =6 \\
\Rightarrow & \frac{a a^{-1}}{6}=6 \\
\Rightarrow & a^{-1}=\frac{6 \times 6}{a} \\
\therefore & 9^{-1}=\frac{6 \times 6}{9}=4
\end{array}$
